decisions.reason: As a close-to-core turnaround software product with standalone visibility, it remains a low-cost strategic option tightly aligned with integrated airport operations, so we keep it while adoption continues to unfold.

This apron connectivity module fits directly with our installed base and systems-integration strengths, and its continuation cost is likely modest relative to the option value of future cross-selling.

Revenue calculation and billing software is somewhat less central to our operational core, but it still extends the digital platform and is worth retaining one more year because airport software buying cycles can be slow.
The apron resource management module is close to our established apron operations offer and supports end-to-end automation, so keeping the option open remains the better choice.

The controller safety alert service is strategically attractive and well aligned with our tower and safety positioning, and despite longer validation and sales cycles it still merits retention for further learning.
